arabic text: QAAFELA ZINDAA SE JAATA HAI MY ZINDAAN MEY HOON TANHA\nAYE BABA JAANAM
english translation text: THE CARAVAN IS LEAVING THE PRISON, BUT I AM STILL IN PRISON ALONE

arabic text: JAB TAK DUNYA BAAQI HAI HOGA MAZLOOMO KA MAATAM\nAYE BABA JAANAM
english translation text: MATAM OF THE OPPRESSED WILL CONTINUE TILL THE END OF TIMES

arabic text:
BABA AAP KE BAAD QAYAAMAT KE WO DIN JO GUZAAREY THEY,
SHIMR NEY KAANO SE DUR CHEENEY AUR TAMAACHEY MAAREY THEY,
INSAANO KEY ROOP MEY THEY HAIWAAN JO DUSHMAN SAAREY THEY
AIK RASAN MEY BANDHEY PHUPII KEY BAAZU THEY AUR MERA GALAA
english translation text:
O BABA, AFTER YOU, WE HAD TO ENDURE SUCH DIFFICULTIES,
SHIMR SNATCHED MY EARNINGS, AND SLAPPED ME,
IN THE SHAPE OF A HUMAN, THESE ENEMIES WERE ACTING LIKE ANIMALS,
THE HAND OF MY AUNT AND MY NECK WERE TIED IN ONE ROPE

arabic text:
BEYKAS HOON AUR BEYBASS HOON MY SHER E QUDAA KI POTII HOON
AAP KE SEENEY PAR SOTI THI AB MATTI MEY SOTI HOON
KOI NAHI JO AANSU POCHEY QABR MEY BHI MY ROTI HOON
YAAD AATA HAI TADPAATA HAI NEHR PEY JAANA AMMU KAA
english translation text:
I AM THE GRANDDAUGHTER OF THE LION OF GOD, BUT I AM HELPLESS,
I USED TO SLEEP ON YOUR CHEST, BUT NOW I SLEEP ON THE GROUND,
THERE IS NO ONE TO WIPE MY TEARS,
I SHIVER WHEN I REMEMBER THE TIME WHEN MY UNCLE WENT TO THE RIVER TO GET WATER

arabic text:
NANHEY ASGAR KO AMMA NEY KITNEY PYAAR SE PAALA THA
USKEY DAMM SE GHAR MEY HAMAAREY QUSHIYAA AUR UJAALA THA
TEER GALEY MEY LAGTEY HI BABA NEY USEY SAMBHAALA THA
ASGAR VEERAANI MEY GHABRAAYA TO KAUN SAMBHAALEYGA
english translation text:
MY MOTHER LOOKED AFTER ASGHAR WITH GREAT CARE,
DUE TO HIM WE HAD JOY AND HAPPINESS IN OUR HOUSE,
MY FATHER CARRIED HIM IN HANDS WHEN HE WAS STUCK WITH AN ARROW
WHO WILL LOOK AFTER MY BROTHER NOW IN THE DARKNESS?

arabic text:
SHAAM KEY JAB BAAZAAR SE GUZREY HUM MAZLOOM JHUKAAYE SAR
AAP KA SAR ZAALIM THEY UTHAAYE BABA NAUK E NAIZA PAR
BAALON SE THI MOO KO CHUPAAYE FATEMA ZEHRA KI DUQTAR
LOG KHADEY YUU DEKH RAHEY THEY JAISEY KOI TAMAASHA THA
english translation text:
WITH OUR HEADS LOOKING DOWN WE WENT THROUGH THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM,
THE OPPRESSOR CARRIED YOUR HEAD ON A SPEAR,
THE DAUGHTERS OF BIBI FATIMA (S.A.) WERE WITHOUT VEILS,
AND THE PEOPLE OF SHAAM WERE STARING AT US

arabic text:
BHAYYA AABID AUR PHUPII AMMA YO MADEENEY JAAYENGEY
GIRYA KARKEY AHLEY WATAN KO SAB ROODAAD SUNAAYENGEY
PURSA DENGEY PURSA LENGEY SAB KO GALEY LAGAAYENGEY
YE BHI KAHENGEY QAID E SITAM MEY MUJHKO WATAN YAAD AATA THA
english translation text: MY BROTHER AND MY AUNT WILL GO TO MEDINA,\nTHEY WILL NARRATE THE STORIES AND CRY ON THE TRAGEDY OF KARBALA,\nTHEY WILL ALSO MENTION THAT IN THE PRISON I USED TO REMEMBER MY HOME

arabic text:
PHOOL BADAN THA QAASIM KA PAAMAAL KIYAA JO LASHKAR NEY
QOON SE KARDI RET PEY QURBAANI TEHREER BAHATTAR NEY
NAUHA KAMAAL NEY LIKHKHAA UNKA AUR PADHAA HAI SAFDAR NEY
RAHEY SALAAMATH MAATAMDAAR YE MERI DAADI KI HAI DUA
english translation text:
THE YOUNG BODY OF QASIM WAS TRAMPLED,
THE SEVENTY TWO MARTYRS GAVE THEIR SACRIFICE,
THE EVENT OF KARBALA IS WRITTEN AND REMEMBERED BY ALL,
MAY THE BLESSINGS BE ON THOSE WHO PERFORM MATAM
